name: voice_diff_approval_waiting
content: The build on "{title}" is waiting on you. It staged a diff over {file_phrase} and nothing gets applied until you approve it.

variables.name: title
variables.description: The task's title. The task id is deliberately NOT offered as a fallback here: this sentence is read aloud, and 'task_' plus thirty-two hex characters is the rough edge the started reply already has.

variables.name: file_phrase
variables.description: Pre-formatted count of changed files, singular or plural ('one file', 'three files'). Formatted server-side so the template carries no pluralisation logic.

metadata.description: Short system message injected into a live voice session when a run this call started has staged a code diff and is waiting for approval. Spoken at most once per proposal, ever — the state is derived from the proposal store on every poll and deduped against a durable log, so this template must read as a one-time nudge rather than as a reminder that will come again.
metadata.author: magician
